cases.subject: Supply Chain Weekly: the year ahead in freight
cases.body:
Special edition: ten forecasts for freight in the new year

Our editors asked analysts at carriers, forwarders and consultancies what they expect from the freight market in the coming twelve months. Here are the main points.

1. Ocean freight. Most analysts expect modest growth in container volumes and continued pressure on rates, because new vessels keep entering service. Several carriers plan to keep blank sailings in the schedule to protect margins.

2. Road freight. Capacity in Europe will remain tight in the east and the Baltic region. Shortage of drivers and higher toll charges are named as the main drivers of cost. Many operators plan to renew their fleets with low-emission trucks, but delivery times of vehicles stay long.

3. Air cargo. Growth will depend on e-commerce volumes. Forecasters see strong demand on routes from Asia, with less pressure on transatlantic lanes.

4. Warehousing. Vacancy rates remain low. Rents for modern logistics space are expected to rise by three to five percent. Operators of temperature-controlled space report the strongest demand.

5. Technology. More shippers plan to use shared platforms for booking dock slots and tracking pallets. Pilot projects begin in the spring.

6. Regulation. New customs rules for small parcels and a revised framework for driving hours will change daily operations of many carriers.

7. Fuel. Analysts see diesel prices within a narrow range, with a risk of short spikes in the winter months.

8. Labour. Wage growth for warehouse and transport staff will continue at around four percent.

9. Sustainability. Reporting requirements for emissions become stricter for large shippers.

10. Risks. Geopolitical events, weather and strikes remain the main sources of sudden disruptions.

The detailed figures and charts are in our paid annual report, which is available to subscribers with a discount until the end of the month.

Supply Chain Weekly | Unsubscribe | Manage preferences

cases.subject: Re: Export documentation: your view needed
cases.body:
Dear Mr Szalewski,

thank you for your last reply, which clarified the question of the certificates of origin. We still need a decision on three points before our customs broker can prepare the March shipments.

1. Will Kordelan act as the exporter of record for all consignments to our warehouse in Malmo, or only for pallets above a certain value? Our broker needs one clear answer.

2. Who bears the cost of the additional customs inspection if the border authority selects a consignment for physical control? Your current terms do not say it explicitly, and in the past this led to a disagreement about a bill of about 300 EUR.

3. Can the temperature log be attached electronically to each consignment, in the same file as the packing list, or do you prefer to send it separately by mail? We would like to avoid paper copies.

We understand that some of these topics belong to your team, but they affect the framework agreement and we would like to hear your own view. A short written answer to the three points is enough. Our broker plans the first March shipment for the first week of the month, so we would appreciate a reply by the end of next week.

Thank you in advance for your help.

Best regards | Karin Lindqvist | Procurement Lead | Nordic Foods Trade

cases.subject: Nowy cennik kart paliwowych: prośba o Pańską decyzję
cases.body:
Szanowny Panie Prezesie,

piszę w sprawie kart paliwowych Kordelan Dystrybucja. Od 1 lutego wprowadzamy nowy model rozliczeń i chciałabym zaproponować Państwu dwa warianty, tak aby mogli Państwo wybrać ten, który lepiej odpowiada profilowi floty.

Wariant pierwszy to stały rabat 7 groszy na litrze oleju napędowego w całej sieci stacji, bez progów miesięcznych. Wariant drugi to rabat progowy: 5 groszy na litrze do 40 000 litrów miesięcznie i 9 groszy powyżej tego poziomu. Przy obecnym zużyciu Państwa floty, według moich wyliczeń, wariant pierwszy daje przewidywalny koszt, a drugi może być tańszy w miesiącach o wysokim ruchu, ale droższy w miesiącach spokojnych.

Dodatkowo proponujemy podniesienie łącznego limitu kredytowego na kartach z 90 000 PLN do 120 000 PLN, co pozwoli uniknąć blokad w okresach szczytu. Zmiana wymaga jednak Pańskiej zgody jako osoby zarządzającej.

Czy mógłby Pan wskazać, który wariant Państwo wybierają i czy zgadza się Pan na wyższy limit? Aby wdrożyć zmianę od lutego, potrzebuję odpowiedzi do 22.01.2027.

W razie pytań chętnie przygotuję symulację na danych z ostatnich sześciu miesięcy, a także spotkam się z Państwa księgową, aby omówić szczegóły rozliczeń i sposób raportowania kosztów paliwa na poszczególne pojazdy.

Regards | Ewelina Marszalek | Key Account Manager | Paliwa-Flota

Cześć Wiktor,

cases.subject: Kalendarz rady na 2027: proszę o Pana opinię
cases.body:
Dzień dobry Wiktorze,

układam z sekretariatem rady kalendarz posiedzeń na cały rok i chcę znać Twoje zdanie, zanim wyślę zaproszenia pozostałym członkom.

Proponuję cztery posiedzenia kwartalne: 28.01.2027, 22.04.2027, 15.07.2027 oraz 21.10.2027. Każde z nich ma trwać pół dnia i zaczynać się o 10:00. Dodatkowo chciałbym zaplanować wizytę rady w naszym magazynie w Gdyni w maju, wraz z kolacją roboczą z kadrą kierowniczą.

W kwietniu przypada Twój wyjazd na targi logistyczne, więc nie jestem pewien, czy termin 22.04.2027 będzie dla Ciebie dogodny. Jeżeli nie, proszę o wskazanie najbliższego dnia, który możemy przyjąć. Zależy mi na tym, aby posiedzenia nie kolidowały z zamknięciem kwartału w księgowości.

Przypominam, że dotychczasowe posiedzenia kończyły się późnym popołudniem, więc proponuję zarezerwować dla rady także wspólny lunch, aby część dyskusji mogła toczyć się w mniej formalnej atmosferze. Chciałbym też wiedzieć, czy wizyta w magazynie w maju jest realna z punktu widzenia obsady i planów operacyjnych. Jeśli tak, proszę o dwa możliwe terminy.

Zależy mi też na tym, aby dokumentacja trafiała do członków rady z odpowiednim wyprzedzeniem, najlepiej na siedem dni przed każdym posiedzeniem. Odpowiedź proszę przesłać do końca tego tygodnia. Po jej otrzymaniu roześlę kalendarz do całej rady.

Z powazaniem | Zbigniew Orlowicz | Przewodniczacy Rady Nadzorczej

cases.subject: Re: Fuel cards: credit limit and the card for the new trailers
cases.body:
Dear Mr Szalewski,

following the message from your accounting department, I would like to ask for your own decision on two questions about the fuel cards.

The first question concerns the limit. Your accountant wrote that the current limit of 90 000 PLN is sufficient for normal months. However, the data for the last quarter show that it was reached twice in the last week of the month, and the cards were blocked for a few hours each time. We would suggest raising the limit to 120 000 PLN, with a free review after six months.

The second question is about the new trailers. When the six refrigerated units arrive, they will need their own cards with a separate cost centre, so that the fuel for the refrigeration units can be accounted separately. Our system can prepare the cards in about ten working days after the order, but we need the list of vehicles and drivers from your side.

Please tell me whether you agree to the higher limit and whether the new cards should be ordered in the same contract. It would help if I could have your answer by 21.01.2027. After that date, the next production run for the cards closes and the delivery would shift by a month.

I am happy to join a short call with your accountant if you prefer to discuss details.

Regards | Ewelina Marszalek | Key Account Manager | Paliwa-Flota

thread.subject: Fuel cards: limit
thread.body: Dear Ms Marszalek, our current limit of 90 000 PLN is enough for normal months and we do not plan changes without the approval of the CEO. Please send the limit data for the last quarter. Magdalena Czerniak

cases.subject: Materiały finansowe na posiedzenie

Dzień dobry Wiktorze,

zbieram materiały na posiedzenie rady i potrzebuję od Ciebie jednej decyzji. Czy w pakiecie dla rady umieszczamy pełny raport o ryzykach flotowych, czy tylko jego dwustronicowe streszczenie?

Zbigniew

cases.subject: Re: Joint tenders: the Baltic hub proposal and your view
cases.body:
Dear Wiktor,

I have read Oliver's first mail about the Baltic hub tender and your short note afterwards, and I would like to follow up personally, because the deadline is close and the decision is yours.

The situation is this. The client, a retail group with stores in three countries, wants a single logistics partner for its Baltic region from September. They ask for a joint offer from our two companies. Oliver sees good margins, but the offer requires a binding capacity commitment of 1 200 pallet places for three years, with a penalty if we fall short.

From our side at Baltic Freight Partners, I am ready to commit 700 of the 1 200 places, if Kordelan takes the remaining 500. We would also share the cost of the bid preparation, which we estimate at about 9 000 EUR, in the same proportion.

My question is simple. Do you support submitting the joint offer on these terms, and would you accept the three-year commitment? I know that this is a strategic choice, and I would rather have your answer in person than through the teams. If you have reservations, tell me what would change your mind, for example the length of the commitment or the share of the penalty.

The submission deadline is 02.02.2027. To prepare the documents, I need your answer by 26.01.2027. I am available for a call at any time that suits you.

Kind regards | Daniel Hargreaves | Managing Partner | Baltic Freight Partners

thread.subject: Re: Baltic hub tender
